[EN] Dark Dreams Sundered
[ES] Sueños oscuros rotos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please be careful.
[ES] Por favor, ten cuidado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We shouldn't have to worry about the Scions of Lok anymore.
[ES] Ya no deberíamos tener que preocuparnos por los Vástagos de Lok.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Enter the Cultists' Refuge and speak with Jelena. [[You must select Cultists' Refuge (Solo) through {@LinkCreature:225#1023#Runha} to advance this quest.]
[ES] Entra en el Refugio de los Cultistas y habla con Jelena. [[Debes seleccionar el Refugio de los Cultistas (Solo) a través de {@LinkCreature:225#1023#Runha} para avanzar en esta misión.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Nullu.
[ES] Habla con Nullu.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Activate the {@linkcreature:3003#1008#Eastern Wardstone} in the northern room to open the gate to the eastern sector. Find {@linkcreature:3003#1023#Davina}.
[ES] Activa la {@linkcreature:3003#1008#Piedra de protección oriental} en la sala norte para abrir la puerta hacia el sector este. Encuentra a {@linkcreature:3003#1023#Davina}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Atel Akaad forever!
[ES] ¡Atel Akaad para siempre!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Urgh...Terkasia...
[ES] Ugh... Terkasia...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat {@linkcreature:3003#3609#Galanos}.
[ES] Derrota a {@linkcreature:3003#3609#Galanos}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Activate the wardstone.
[ES] Activa la piedra de protección.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Activate the {@linkcreature:3003#1011#Western Wardstone} and open the western sector entrance. [Select 'Look at the crest.' on the Western Wardstone to open the entrance.]
[ES] Activa la {@linkcreature:3003#1011#Western Wardstone} y abre la entrada del sector occidental. [Selecciona 'Mirar el blasón' en el Western Wardstone para abrir la entrada.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Understood."
[ES] "Comprendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Activate the Western Wardstone, then return to Jelena in the central hallway.
[ES] Activa el Western Wardstone y luego regresa con Jelena en el pasillo central.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm on it."
[ES] "En eso estoy."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Nullu.
[ES] Habla con Nullu.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Western Sector of the Cultists' Refuge
[ES] Sector occidental del Cultists' Refuge
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] That woman looks suspicious. Interrogate her.
[ES] Esa mujer parece sospechosa. Interrógala.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Scout the western sector and find High Priestess Akia.
[ES] Reconoce el sector occidental y encuentra a la High Priestess Akia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate High Priestess Akia and Terkasia.
[ES] Elimina a la High Priestess Akia y a Terkasia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Interesting. I'll look into that."
[ES] "Interesante. Investigaré eso."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Elleon.
[ES] Habla con Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the explosives to destroy Samael's Soul Stone.
[ES] Usa los explosivos para destruir la Soul Stone de Samael.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I was glad to help."
[ES] "Me alegro de haber ayudado."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Elleon.
[ES] Preséntate ante Elleon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
